jobs.occupation: Lead Engineer - Applied AI & Data Products
jobs.description:
1 Lead Engineer - Applied AI & Data Products from now

Your Tasks
 * AI-Powered Product Architecture: Design and own the architecture of AI-enhanced software products using modern cloud services and frameworks (e.g., Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, LangChain).
 * Applied LLM Expertise: Apply Large Language Models (LLMs), cognitive services, and related technologies to solve complex, high-impact customer problems independently.
 * Customer Consulting: Lead workshops and technical discussions with product managers, designers, and customer stakeholders, representing SQUER with confidence and identifying where AI adds measurable value.
 * Scalable Systems Design: Architect scalable data pipelines and APIs that power intelligent features in production-grade environments, taking full technical ownership.
 * Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Guide and develop engineers within your team, shape our applied AI engineering practices, and ensure project and team success.
 * Thought Leadership: Represent SQUER's applied AI expertise externally - through client relationships, internal knowledge-sharing, or community engagement.

Your Qualifications
 * Extensive Software Engineering Experience: Several years of hands-on and architectural experience in software engineering (e.g., Python, Java, C#, JS/TS, or similar).
 * Applied AI Depth: Proven, independent experience applying AI services in production (e.g., LLMs, NLP APIs, cognitive services), not just experimenting.
 * Cloud Platform Ownership: Confident designing and deploying AI-driven features on AWS, GCP, or Azure at production scale.
 * Data & API Architecture: Strong understanding of data processing, APIs, and databases (SQL & NoSQL), with the ability to make architectural decisions independently.
 * Leadership & Mentorship: Ability to guide, coach, and develop other engineers, and to take responsibility for a team's delivery and satisfaction.
 * Customer-Facing Confidence: Comfortable representing SQUER independently to customers with a high degree of professionalism.
 * Languages: Fluency in German and English.

Your Benefits
Why You'll Love Working at SQUER:

 * Ownership & Responsibility: at SQUER, we believe in empowering our team. In our flat hierarchies, your ideas and actions matter more than titles. Take the reins, make an impact and grow with us.
 * Learn & Grow: Tap into a € 5.000 annual training budget to sharpen your skills and take advantage of our in-house Leadership Academy. Join and be part of our active tech community through meetups, hackathons and training sessions. Get up to 40h/year additional time off for your personal education.
 * Flexibility for Performance: Benefit from hybrid work options, flexible hours, workations within the EU, and additional vacation days - giving you the freedom to perform at your best.
 * Tailored Tools for Success: Choose your preferred hardware configuration and leverage our suite of AI tools and licenses (Anthropic, OpenAI, and more) to suit your working style.
 * We Value You: Beyond perks and benefits, we offer a competitive annual salary to recognize your exceptional contributions.
 * A Perks-Packed Workplace: Work in a central office with a spacious terrace and BBQ, enjoy free lunch in the office, MyClubs sports membership, and either a free "Wiener Linien" ticket or a partial contribution to the "Klimaticket". Plus, benefit from free massages, referral bonuses, Corporate Benefits, and JobRad. Annual employee presents and a monthly team breakfast add extra value to your work experience.

We believe in transparent and fair compensation. For this role, the annual gross salary ranges between 
€ 75.000 and € 95.000 - the exact placement depends on the seniority level we assess together
during the process.

We build AI voice agents for small and medium-sized businesses so they never miss a call and can focus on the work they actually love.

Our AI handles every call automatically. But voice is just the beginning. Our vision: to build the world's first fully automated CRM.

11,000+ customers. >€15M ARR. ~30% monthly growth.

We live ownership. You're responsible for your projects and tasks end-to-end. No politics, few meetings, direct feedback. At fonio you'll build alongside the smartest and most ambitious people around.

Join us now to be part of one of Europe's most exciting growth stories! 1 Junior Customer Success Manager (DACH) (m/f/d) Your Role

As Junior Customer Success Manager for Activation in DACH, you make sure every new German-speaking customer goes from "just signed" to "fonio picks up our calls every day". You own the first weeks of the customer journey: setting up their AI assistant, testing and fine-tuning it, and getting it live on their phone line.

You'll spend most of your time in onboarding calls with customers and inside the fonio platform. You learn how every feature works and figure out the best setup for each customer, whether that's a dental practice in Munich, a law firm in Vienna or a car workshop in Zurich.

 

What to expect

 * Run onboarding calls with new DACH customers and set up their AI assistant together with them

 * Translate each customer's business into a working setup: prompt, knowledge base, call transfers, notifications and integrations

 * Test and fine-tune assistants until they're ready to go live, so customers don't get stuck in "almost done"

 * Help customers connect their phone system and get call forwarding running

 * Follow up with customers who signed but aren't active yet, and get them over the line

 * Become a power user of the platform: learn how each feature works and which setup fits which use case

 * Bring patterns and friction points from onboardings back to Product and CS to improve templates, guides and the product

 * Hand activated customers over to Customer Success with a clean setup and clear notes

 * Track your onboardings and activation results in HubSpot

 

Who We're Looking For

 * 0-2 years of experience in a customer-facing role (onboarding, support, CS, sales, hospitality or customer service) or a strong graduate profile. Internships count.

 * German, fluent English

 * Basic technical skills and real curiosity about how things work. You enjoy clicking through a platform until you understand it, and you're not scared of webhooks, APIs or phone settings.

 * You like solving puzzles: "How do I build this for this customer?" excites you

 * You explain things simply and stay patient with non-technical customers, by phone or video

 * Structured: you can run several onboardings in parallel without dropping anything

 * Hands-on and quick to learn. You take initiative and don't wait to be told what to do.

 * Willing to relocate to Vienna

What We Offer

 * €50,000-55,000

 * You'll learn AI and voice tech faster than anywhere else, with a real path into Customer Success, Solutions or Forward Deployment

 * Lunch and dinner are on us. Every day.

 * The fridge is always full: Red Bull, Mate, Cola, Almdudler and more

 * Need a tool, course or book? It's yours. No approval loops.

 * Your setup, your choice: pick the gear you want to work with

 * A product customers actually love: 4.5 stars on Trustpilot, Google and OMR. It mostly sells itself.

 * Onsite in Vienna with a team that's here to do the best work of their careers

 

Hiring Process

 * 20 min intro call

 * 30 min skill interview

 * 15 min with interview with our CCO

 * 20 min culture call with our Founders

The Associate Operations Manager for Supply Activation & Acquisition plays a pivotal role at Wolt. As Central scales at an unprecedented pace, your mission is to keep courier supply ahead of demand - both in the moment and over the medium term. You will be responsible for leading and mentoring a team of 3, ensuring that intraday activation (weather-driven boosts, DxGy and ARC / radius adjustments) and courier acquisition (job boards, application attainment, reactivations and sign-ups) are tightly coordinated across all Central markets.

Your ability to translate data into fast, defensible calls will be key to keeping Central's ADT, UH% and GOV loss on plan.

What you'll be doing

 * Own Central's intraday activation strategy - activation surges, special events management and day-to-day operations (radius / busyness adjustments, communication flows, etc.) - to keep courier supply matched to demand hour by hour.

 * Lead and mentor a team of 3 and own a multi-million euro activation and acquisition budget across Central markets.

 * Own Central's courier acquisition function: job boards, application attainment, reactivation campaigns and sign-ups.

 * Own and report on Central's UH% and GOV loss KPIs weekly, surfacing risks and driving corrective action with senior leadership.

 * Plan and execute mobilizer strategies and special events coverage (holidays, weather events, local events) ahead of demand spikes.

 * Partner with Support, Product and Global Delivery Ops to build tools and processes that scale activation and acquisition across markets.

 * Serve as the primary point of contact for top management on Central's supply health.

Our humble expectations

 * Proven track record managing complex, data-driven operations across multiple markets, ideally in courier / gig supply, logistics or marketplace operations.

 * Comfortable owning hard KPIs (UH%, GOV loss) and being accountable for the numbers, not just reporting them.

 * Experience leading and developing a small team (3 direct reports).

 * Strong budget ownership experience - able to allocate and defend a multi-million euro spend across activation and acquisition levers.

 * Excellent ability to distill complex operational trade-offs into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.

 * Comfortable working under time pressure during weather events, special events and demand spikes.

 * Fluent English skills in both spoken and writing.
